Brave New World

ISBN: 9780099477464

  • Aldous Huxley
  • 1932
  • 229 pages
  • 4.0
Finished
Started: 2026-01-10 Finished: 2026-01-20

Review

4.0

Brave New World paints a haunting vision of a future where pleasure and control are manipulated to create a perfectly stable society - yet, at the expense of humanity's soul.
Wow did Huxley predicted todays social media industry with this one?
Huxley's exploration of consumerism and loss of individuality still feels incredibly relevant today.
